description: This source file contains functions related to firmware upgrade operations for Linksys devices within the OpenWrt project. It includes functions to determine the target firmware partition, manage upgrade process logic based on environment variables, and handle flashing the firmware image to specific memory partitions.
external_files: <other external commands or tools like fw_setenv, get_magic_long, find_mtd_part, nand_upgrade_tar, nand_do_upgrade_success, nand_do_upgrade_failed, get_image, and mtd write from the build environment>

methods.name: linksys_get_target_firmware
methods.description: Determines the target firmware partition based on current boot environment and UBI device details. It sets the environment variables for the next boot and indicates which kernel to boot.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_linksys
methods.description: Handles the upgrade process by identifying the target partition, verifying image magic values, and executing the appropriate flash commands to upgrade the firmware.
